goal: Create a dependency-free Python module implementing parse_enabled(value: str) -> bool.

requirements.text: Export parse_enabled(value: str) -> bool. Document accepted inputs and exception behavior.
Strip surrounding whitespace and ignore case. Accept only true, 1, yes as True; false, 0, no as False. Raise ValueError for every other string and TypeError for non-string input.
Work on Python 3.10+ without third-party dependencies, import-time output, or import-time application actions.
